prompts.greeting: Good to see another willing pair of hands. The stores are thin, and the road is long.
prompts.questIntro: I'm short on supplies — if you can spare the time, I'd see you well-paid for the trouble.
prompts.topic: He keeps the guild's storeroom and weighs every coin twice. Was a caravan guard before a bad winter cost him three fingers.

firstMeet: New face. Don't tell me your name yet; names are for people who come back.
You'll want the stores. Everyone does. Sign here, and mind the ink, it's the last of it.

stranger: Stores are thin. If you're here to ask for something, ask quick.
Three fingers, before you ask. Winter on the caravan road. I don't recommend it.
known: Back again. Good. The ones who come back are the ones I write down.
Counted the planks twice this morning. Came out different both times. Don't tell Mira.
friend: Sit a minute. The ledger can wait, which is a thing I don't say to many.
You remind me of a guard I rode with. He was better at cards and worse at living.
trusted: If the guild ever asks who I'd trust with the keys, I've already written your name.
I kept the caravan bell. It's the only thing I brought back from that road. You'll see it someday.

questActive: Still on my errand? Good. I'm not paying for half a job.
The stores don't fill themselves. Go on.
questTurnIn: There it is. I'll weigh it, but I already know it's right.
You came back with it. That puts you ahead of most.
giftLiked: Timber? You've been listening. Over here, by the dry wall.
Now that's useful. I'll not forget it.
giftMeh: Kind of you. I'll find a shelf for it.

questComplete.qt_aldric_road_3: The road is quieter now. I'll sleep tonight, which I've not done in a while. Take this; it's a better blade than the one that cost me.

prompts.greeting: Eyes on the treeline. The forest hasn't been quiet since the harvest moon.
prompts.questIntro: Something's been thinning the patrols. I need a blade willing to walk the bad mile.
prompts.topic: Veteran ranger who runs the Haven scouts. Speaks little, watches everything. Carries a bow most archers can't draw.

firstMeet: You walk loud. We'll fix that, or the forest will.
Hm. Another one. Keep your eyes on the treeline and your mouth shut, and you'll last.

stranger: Patrol's late. Patrol's always late.
Don't stand in the doorway. Things watch doorways.
known: You again. The scouts have started calling you 'the one who comes back.' High praise, from them.
Something is moving at night that doesn't belong to any beast I've tracked.
friend: I'll say this once. You've earned a place at my fire.
When I was young I thought the forest was the enemy. It isn't. It's a witness.
trusted: There's a mile out past the old markers that none of my scouts will walk. I'd walk it with you.
If I don't come back one of these days, the bow is yours. No arguing.

questActive: Report when it's done, not before.
The bad mile doesn't walk itself.
questTurnIn: Done? Show me.
Good. Quietly done, too. I noticed.
giftLiked: Trophies. You're learning what matters out there.
A bow. You know what I carry. That means something.
giftMeh: I've no use for it, but I'll take the thought.

questComplete.qt_mira_mile_3: The bad mile's just a mile now. Take the longbow. It was going to be yours either way.

prompts.greeting: Mind the jars, dear. Some of these will weep if you stare too long.
prompts.questIntro: I've a recipe that calls for ingredients you won't find on a market stall. Up for a wander?
prompts.topic: Herbalist and rumored hedge witch. Trades remedies for stories and occasionally the truth.

firstMeet: Mind the jars, dear. Some of them mind you back.
Oh, a new one. Don't touch the blue one. The blue one touches back.

stranger: Remedies for coin, stories for free, truth for a price we'll discuss.
Did you know a slime will cure a fever if you ask it nicely? You have to ask nicely.
known: You've the look of someone who's been bitten by something. Sit, let me see.
I dreamt of you last night. Don't be flattered; I dream of everyone.
friend: Come, I've a tea that will tell you what you're afraid of. Or it's just mint. Hard to say.
The hedge witch rumours are only half true, and I won't say which half.
trusted: I'll teach you the recipe my mother wouldn't teach me. Seems fair.
You've become one of my favourite stories. Don't end badly.

questActive: Did you find them? The green ones, not the greenish ones.
Patience. Plants don't hurry and neither should you.
questTurnIn: Let me smell those. Yes. Yes, those are the ones.
Lovely. Still damp with the swamp, just as they should be.
giftLiked: Oh! Fresh. You've a good eye for a leaf.
Gel from a slime. You asked it nicely, I hope.
giftMeh: It's not an ingredient, but it'll do as a paperweight.

prompts.greeting: Ah — a willing reader? Or a willing climber? The library has need of both.
prompts.questIntro: There are places marked on these maps that have no business existing. Walk one with me, even if only in proxy.
prompts.topic: Catalogs ruins, ledgers, and bestiary entries. Believes the world is older than the histories admit.

firstMeet: Ah. You have the look of a reader. Or a climber. The library needs both, and pays neither.
Don't mind the dust. It's older than the books, and the books are older than Haven.

stranger: The histories say Haven is four hundred years old. The foundations say otherwise.
I catalogue things. Ruins, ledgers, monsters. Mostly ledgers.
known: I've marked a room on the catacomb map that shouldn't be there. It's there.
You've been places I've only read about. Tell me one true thing about them.
friend: Between us, I think the bestiary is wrong about ghosts. I think they remember.
I've started a page with your name on it. I hope to fill it slowly.
trusted: There is a door under the peak. I've never told anyone. I'm telling you.
Whatever we find down there, promise you'll write it down. That's all I ask.

questActive: Have you reached it yet? Describe the stonework when you return.
Take notes. Take more than you think you need.
questTurnIn: You're back, and whole. Both are good for the record.
Show me what you found. Slowly.
giftLiked: A specimen! You have no idea what this confirms.
Gears from the Enclave. I have theories. So many theories.
giftMeh: Not for the collection, but thank you. I'll note the gesture.

questComplete.qt_vidar_old_3: Then the histories are wrong, and we are the only two who know it. Take the staff; it came out of a ruin older than any of this.

prompts.greeting: Walk softly past this table. The wrong ears could undo a year of careful work.
prompts.questIntro: A favor for a friend, paid in coin and quieter gratitudes. Are you discreet?
prompts.topic: Speaks for several factions, owes loyalty to none. Treaties she's drafted have outlasted the kings who signed them.

firstMeet: Walk softly past this table. I'm doing three people's work and none of it is mine.
A stranger. Good. Strangers can carry things that friends can't.

stranger: I speak for several factions. None of them are speaking to each other this week.
Discretion is the only coin worth hoarding.
known: You've kept your mouth shut about me. I notice who doesn't talk.
Half of diplomacy is knowing which fire to sit at. The other half is leaving before it goes out.
friend: I'll tell you a treaty's real terms some day. Not today. But some day.
The kings I've outlasted would envy you your simple problems.
trusted: If a letter comes for you with my seal and no words, run. That's the deal.
You're the only one in Haven who's never asked me what I want. Ask, if you like.

questActive: Quietly. Whatever it is, quietly.
The favour stands. So does the gratitude, once it's done.
questTurnIn: Done, and no one the wiser? You'd make a passable courier.
Good. Say nothing, as before.
giftLiked: Pearls. You understand that some gifts are also messages.
Silver speaks in rooms where I can't.
giftMeh: Thoughtful. I'll pass it along to someone who needs it more.

prompts.greeting: Hot iron first, conversation second. Bench's free if you've got steady hands.
prompts.questIntro: I need ore the merchants won't sell, of a kind that doesn't sing in the cart. You game?
prompts.topic: Built the gates of Haven himself. Half the guild's swords carry his maker's mark; the other half wish they did.

firstMeet: Don't lean on that. It's cooling. Everything in here is cooling or burning.
A customer or an apprentice? Both pay, one way or another.

stranger: I built the gates. Every time they hold, I take it personally.
Bronze is for learning. Iron is for keeping.
known: Your blade's holding an edge? Good. Means you're swinging it right.
Half the guild's swords have my mark. The other half will, eventually.
friend: Come by the forge after dark some night. I'll show you the fold I don't teach.
You've got smith's hands. Pity you keep hitting monsters with them.
trusted: When I'm gone, someone needs to keep the gates. I'm starting to think it's you.
I made a thing for you. It's not done. It won't be for a while. But it's yours.

questActive: Ore doesn't dig itself. Back to it.
I've the forge hot. Don't make me let it cool.
questTurnIn: Hand it here. Let me feel the weight.
That's good metal. That's good work.
giftLiked: Iron! Now you're speaking my language.
Ingots. Someone's been listening at the forge.
giftMeh: Not metal. But I'll find a use, or Marrick will.

prompts.greeting: Sit, sit. The fire knows you, even if I don't yet.
prompts.questIntro: There's a thread I've been pulling on for forty years. I think I finally need a younger hand to follow it.
prompts.topic: The Haven elder. Tells stories that turn out to be maps. Knows more than he lets on, and lets on more than is wise.

firstMeet: Sit. No, not there, that's where the cat sits. Sit anywhere else.
Ah, a young one. I've a story for you. Several. We'll start with the short one.

stranger: Did I ever tell you about the quarry? No? That's because I haven't yet.
Everything's a map if you fold it right.
known: You've the look of someone who's been listening. Dangerous habit. Keep it.
The elder before me said the forest whispers. He was half right. It mutters.
friend: I'll tell you where the old road goes, one of these days. When you're ready to not come back the same.
You know, you're in one of my stories now. Not a big part. Yet.
trusted: The thing in the catacombs has a name. I'll say it once, and only to you.
When I'm gone, the stories go with me, unless someone's been writing them down. Hint, hint.

questActive: Patience, young one. The story isn't finished and neither are you.
Go on, then. I'll be here. I'm always here.
questTurnIn: Back already? Then I owe you the rest of the tale.
Good. Now I've a new story, and it's about you.
giftLiked: Ah, for the knees. You're a kind one.
Firewood. The young never think of firewood. You did.
giftMeh: That's very… what is it? Never mind. Thank you.

prompts.greeting: Step where I step. The forest forgives mistakes only twice.
prompts.questIntro: Something's been moving against the grain in here. I want a second pair of eyes, and a sharper pair of teeth.
prompts.topic: Lives among the boughs and won't say where she sleeps. Reads tracks the way scholars read books.

firstMeet: You didn't see me until I let you. Remember that.
Quiet now. There's a wolf behind you that hasn't decided yet.

stranger: The tracks here are wrong. Something walks on two legs and four.
I don't sleep where people can find me. Nothing personal.
known: You've learned to step on the roots, not the leaves. Took you long enough.
The forest tolerates you. That's further than most get.
friend: I'll show you the hollow where I keep the rain off. Don't tell the scouts.
Mira sends her captains. I only talk to the ones who come back twice.
trusted: The forest told me your name before you did. Don't ask how.
If the trees ever go quiet, come find me. That's the only warning you'll get.

questActive: Not done? The forest can tell.
Tread lightly. The bandits have ears in the bracken.
questTurnIn: The tracks say you did it. Show me anyway.
Well. The forest was right about you.
giftLiked: Fur. Warm. You know what the nights are like up here.
A clean bone. The wolves will respect that.
giftMeh: I've nowhere to put it, but I'll remember you brought it.

prompts.greeting: Mind the loose stone. The Quarry takes a finger before it takes a friend.
prompts.questIntro: The deep seams have gone strange. I need ore from a face most won't touch.
prompts.topic: Runs the cutting crews. His grandfather opened these tunnels; his cousin closed half of them. He doesn't talk about which.

firstMeet: Crew's full. Unless you can swing a pick, in which case the crew's not full.
Mind the east tunnel. It's closed. It'll stay closed.

stranger: Grandfather opened these tunnels. We don't talk about who closed the others.
Stone doesn't lie. Men do. I prefer stone.
known: You've got dust in the right creases now. That's how I tell.
The golems don't come from nowhere. Somebody made them. Long time ago.
friend: There's a seam in the north face nobody's touched. I'll show you, and only you.
My cousin was a good man before the east tunnel. Don't ask what after.
trusted: If you ever hear hammering from the closed tunnels, that's not us. Leave.
When I retire, which is never, the crews would follow you. I've asked them.

questActive: Ore first, talk after.
Crew's counting on you. Don't make me count again.
questTurnIn: Let's see the haul. Good weight.
Clean cut. You've learned.
giftLiked: Ore. You get it. Most don't.
Planks for the shoring. You've been in the tunnels.
giftMeh: Not much use underground. But the crew'll like it.

prompts.greeting: You waded all this way. I'd say I'm flattered, but the swamp does most of the inviting.
prompts.questIntro: There's a bloom that only opens when the water is wrong. I'd fetch it myself, but my hip's been wrong for a decade.
prompts.topic: Lives where the road ends. Trades cures no one else can make for favors that come due years later.

firstMeet: The road ends here. Most people turn around. You didn't.
Don't drink from the pools. Don't ask why. Sit.

stranger: I trade cures for favours. The favours come due later. Always later.
The mist knows your name. I know it too, now.
known: You came back through the swamp. Few do that twice on purpose.
There's a fever in the frogs this year. Nothing to do with me.
friend: I'll make you the cure no one else can. Payment will be strange. It always is.
You've a favour owed to me. I haven't decided what it is yet.
trusted: The hermit before me vanished into the mist. I'm telling you so that someone knows where to look.
I'll teach you the one remedy that costs nothing. That's the rarest kind.

questActive: The swamp will give you what I need. Let it.
You're owed nothing until it's done. Even then, not much.
questTurnIn: Give them here. Yes. These will do.
Good. The favour is paid. Mostly.
giftLiked: Red herb. You know what grows where.
Essence. You've been among the dead. I can smell it.
giftMeh: Not a thing I'd use. But the mist takes all gifts.

prompts.greeting: You hear it too, don't you. Down here, even the silence has a name.
prompts.questIntro: I came down to find someone. I think I found her, but she's not… finished. I need a witness.
prompts.topic: Wanderer who never quite leaves the catacombs. Speaks gently to no one in particular and waits for answers.

firstMeet: Oh. You're alive. That's rarer down here than you'd think.
Don't be afraid. They're mostly not listening.

stranger: I came down for someone. I think. It's been a while.
The dead keep good time. Better than I do.
known: You again. The skeletons have started to leave you a path. Have you noticed?
I speak to them. Sometimes I think one answers.
friend: I remember her name now. I'll tell you, if you'll remember it after I forget again.
Sit. There's a quiet corner that the ghosts leave alone. It's mine. It can be yours.
trusted: I think I'm one of them. I think I have been for some time. Thank you for not saying so.
If you find a way out that isn't the way in, take it. Don't wait for me.

questActive: Are they still there? They'll be there. They're always there.
Careful with the ghost. It doesn't know it's doing harm.
questTurnIn: You came back. They told me you might.
Yes. Thank you. The halls feel lighter.
giftLiked: Essence. It hums. Can you hear it hum?
Silver. They don't like silver. I do.
giftMeh: I've nowhere to keep it. I'll leave it for whoever comes next.

prompts.greeting: Mind the gears. They don't dislike you yet, but they're working on it.
prompts.questIntro: The Enclave's old escapements are slipping. I need parts that the workshops in Haven simply don't make any more.
prompts.topic: Inherited the Clockwork Enclave from a teacher who walked into one of its rooms and never came back out.

firstMeet: Don't touch anything that ticks. Don't touch anything that doesn't tick, either.
Visitor. Rare. The automatons must like you, or you'd not have reached the door.

stranger: My teacher walked into the third chamber and never walked out. I keep the door oiled.
Everything here was built by someone who meant well. That's the frightening part.
known: You survive the drones. That's a credential, around here.
I've nearly worked out what the Enclave is for. Nearly. I've been nearly for six years.
friend: Come and see the engine room. No one has, since him.
If I show you my notes, you'll see where I stopped being sure. Don't laugh.
trusted: I'm going to open the third chamber. I'd like you there. I'd like someone there.
Whatever my teacher found in there, I think it's still running. I think it's waiting.

questActive: The parts don't come out of the machines willingly.
Back to it. The Enclave doesn't repair itself. Actually, it does. That's the problem.
questTurnIn: Let me see. Oh, that's a good one. That's an early one.
You got it out intact. I've lost three apprentices trying.
giftLiked: Gears! From where? No, don't tell me, let me guess by the teeth.
A canister with pressure in it still. You are careful. Good.
giftMeh: Not mechanical, but I'll put it on the shelf with the other mysteries.
